content.conceptsText: Before diving into applications, it's important to understand the fundamental concepts that underpin this technology. These building blocks form the foundation of how these systems work and why they're so powerful.
content.applicationsText: The applications of this technology span across numerous industries, from healthcare to finance, manufacturing to entertainment. Here are some of the most impactful use cases:

content.codeExample:
import tensorflow as tf
import numpy as np

# Simple neural network example
model = tf.keras.Sequential([
  tf.keras.layers.Dense(128, activation='relu', input_shape=(784,)),
  tf.keras.layers.Dropout(0.2),
  tf.keras.layers.Dense(10, activation='softmax')
])

model.compile(
  optimizer='adam',
  loss='sparse_categorical_crossentropy',
  metrics=['accuracy']
)
